name: CÀ PHÊ SỚM
tagline: Specialty Vietnamese coffee, roasted in District 3

brief.name: Cà Phê Sớm
brief.industry: Specialty coffee house & roastery in Ho Chi Minh City — cà phê sữa đá, robusta single-origin, and a slow weekend brew bar
brief.audience: Young urban Saigonese 20-35 and visitors who want modern specialty coffee with real Vietnamese identity; remote workers; weekend brunch crowd.
brief.tone: modern, warm, confident, neighbourhood, unfussy, proud-local
brief.references: The Coffee House, Highlands Coffee, Phúc Long, modern HCMC roasteries; Momo for clean app-era UI
brief.context: Hero with the Vietnamese tagline rendered in Be Vietnam Pro — diacritics must be flawless (Cà Phê Sớm, sữa đá). Sections: signature menu (cà phê sữa đá, bạc xỉu, cold brew) with prices in ₫, the roastery story, brew bar booking, gallery, find-us map (Quận 3). Lacquer-red + gold + lotus accents, modern not folkloric.
brief.avoid: Broken or missing diacritics. Latin-only text. Conical-hat / rice-paddy tourist imagery. Festival-poster loudness. Western café template with Vietnamese words pasted in.
